landing.heroTitle: One track from the API catalog to your first call.
landing.heroText: Discover curated APIs on the gateway, get credentials on your own, and monitor your application's usage — no tickets, no waiting for days.

steps.d: Create an account with your organization email; an admin approves your access.
One application becomes one consumer identity on the gateway.
Pick an API and a rate-limit plan, then wait for approval.

steps.t: Call it with an API key
steps.d: Generate credentials and test right away from Try It.
